# Known-answer tests from the NIST ACVP-Server vectors
# (https://github.com/usnistgov/ACVP-Server, gen-val/json-files/*/internalProjection.json):
# the first case of each group, with SHA-256 digests in place of large outputs.
# mlkem_keygen: seed (d || z) -> SHA-256 of ek. mlkem_encap: ek, m -> SHA-256 of c, and k.
# mldsa_keygen: seed -> SHA-256 of pk. mldsa_verify: an invalid external-mu signature.
# mldsa_sign: ACVP sigGen has expanded private keys only, so these hedged
#   signatures are of an ACVP keyGen seed over the mu (pure ML-DSA, computed from
#   the message and context) and rnd of an ACVP sigGen case, signed with
#   libcrux-ml-dsa (an implementation independent of every backend's signing).
